cases.description: An add_claim references a request-local ID not established by an earlier edit.
A session-b request dereferences n1~session-a even if session-b has its own n1.
Host-issued operation IDs are monotonic and unique; a replay projection containing a repeated ID at another ordinal is invalid.
The same idempotency key is reused with a different expected revision or edit payload.
Document evidence handle belongs to another source/session.
Withdraw targets an imported claim. Draft withdrawal cannot express authoritative retraction.
An active claim/reference/hypothesis/question points to a record in the graph being released.
Two active hypotheses target distinct existing nodes with equal labels. Both remain candidates and check reports ambiguity; neither is merged.
